strategy_roster.name: Momentum M15
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(Open,23) below -0.2 corresponds to momentum under the 99.8 bound, while close above SMA(Low,26) approximates the shifted average filter. The MA shift, monotonic 6/10-bar windows, gap lockout, and optional point trail are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: X Trader V3
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossbelow(sma((high + low) / 2,16),sma((high + low) / 2,1)) and bars_since(sma((high + low) / 2,16) > sma((high + low) / 2,1)) >= 2
strategy_roster.notes: Median-price SMA(16/1) preserves the documented unusual long crossover and the two-bar persistence test using bars_since. The time window and 100/150-tick stops are not expressible in this DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Ichimoku Price Action
strategy_roster.notes: The documented optional MACD direction filter is represented by a 12/26/9 signal cross; lengths are explicit fallbacks. Time-of-day selection, Ichimoku fields, fixed/ATR/swing stops, break-even, and trailing are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Color PEMA Digit TM Plus MMRec Duplex (C#)
strategy_roster.notes: EMA slope turns approximate the long PEMA color switch; EMA(5/21) are fallbacks because smoothing and signal-bar values are unspecified. Pentuple EMA, rounding, dual streams, timers, and step protection are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Tunnel Method
strategy_roster.notes: The 20/160 SMA tunnel and 20/80 exit retain the documented long breakout and bearish reversal, with 1% used as a price-scale proxy for one pip. SMA shifts 0/1/2, cadence, and 50/50/5-point management are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Donchian Stochastic
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar high breakout within five bars is confirmed by a negative three-bar return as a lagging Stochastic %K<20 proxy, with opposite breakout or momentum recovery exiting. The documented 2% stop is retained; all lengths are fallbacks.

strategy_roster.name: Hans Indicator Cloud System
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar prior range approximates the two Hans cloud sessions and their upper/lower breakout; the mirrored band exits. Cloud colors, timezone sessions, signal-bar shift, and entry buffer are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Balance Of Power Histogram
strategy_roster.notes: The exact documented BOP formula is used, and ROC(1) detects its current turn because explicit two-bar history is unavailable. The four-hour schedule and advanced money management are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: BadOrders
strategy_roster.notes: This demonstration intentionally submits invalid pending orders rather than defining a trade, so impossible guards prevent fabricated entries. Tick bid, 100-point modification, rejection, and close-reopen state cannot be represented.

strategy_roster.name: Stoch Komposter
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) crossing the documented lower level 30 is used as a bounded Stochastic %K proxy, with a cross above 70 as exit. Stochastic periods, ATR arrows, and 1000/2000 price-unit protection are unavailable.
